jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Learning-Based Multi-Agent Control under Uncertainty
jobs.description:
The Department of Electronic Systems at the Technical Faculty of IT and Design invites applications for a postdoc in learning-based multi-agent control under uncertainty, with applications to autonomous multi-robot systems operating in dynamic and uncertain environments, as per February 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is available for a period of 2 years.

Your work tasks   The position focuses on fundamental research in learning-based planning and control of interacting autonomous agents under uncertainty. You will develop new theoretical and algorithmic approaches for distributed and cooperative control, combining learning or online adaptation with principled treatment of safety, robustness, and performance. Research challenges include uncertain dynamics and disturbances, partial or noisy information, changing interactions between agents, and limited or unreliable communication.

A central part of the work will be to formulate rigorous methods and establish their properties, for example concerning stability, safety, constraint satisfaction, robustness, and convergence, where applicable. Depending on the research direction, the work may draw on learning-augmented model predictive control, safe reinforcement learning, data-driven modelling and safety mechanism (e.g. CBF), distributed optimization, or robust and adaptive control. You will develop reproducible numerical studies and simulations to examine the strengths, limitations, and scalability of the proposed methods.

The research will be carried out in the Horizon Europe ROX-6G project, where heterogeneous robot teams provide a compelling application for coordination under uncertain conditions and connectivity constraints. Although the position is primarily theoretical, you will collaborate with colleagues working on robotic implementation and will contribute to experimental validation. You will lead and co-author publications in international journals and conferences, engage with project partners, contribute to research planning and scientific discussions, and support knowledge exchange within the team.

Your competencies

We seek a researcher with a PhD in control engineering, robotics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, or a closely related field, and a strong background in mathematical modelling, control, optimization, or multi-agent systems.

You should be able to formulate original research problems, develop and analyse rigorous methods, and demonstrate research quality through peer-reviewed scientific publications. Experience in learning-based control, robust or nonlinear control, distributed control, or decision-making under uncertainty is particularly relevant; expertise in every one of these areas is not expected.

You should have good scientific programming skills, for example in Python, MATLAB, or C++, and be able to evaluate algorithms systematically through simulation. We value independent research initiative, clear scientific writing, and the ability to work constructively with researchers from different disciplines and backgrounds. Experience with autonomous robots, ROS/ROS 2, multi-robot simulation, or physical robotic experiments will be considered an advantage, but is not a prerequisite for this primarily theory-oriented position. Excellent written and spoken English is required.

Who we are

In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 600 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

The position is hosted in the Automation and Control Section, within a collaborative robotics research environment combining fundamental research with real-world applications.

In addition, you will work with an international team and research partners in ROX-6G, a European collaboration addressing autonomous robotic operations in demanding underground environments. Our research interests span safe and resilient decision-making, learning-enabled control, distributed multi-robot coordination, and validation in simulation and on robotic platforms. We encourage scientific independence, close exchange of ideas, and publication of high-quality research. More information: www.es.aau.dk.

The National Center of Excellence PREDICT at Aalborg University in Copenhagen is looking to recruit a motivated and dedicated biostatistician with an interest in the technical part of research to join our international and interdisciplinary group of researchers in a double role as biostatistician and technical contact person. The position is for 3 years, full-time (37 hours per week) and is open for appointment from March 1st 2027.

Your work tasks

As biostatistician in PREDICT you will be involved in epidemiological studies of risk factors for IBD, pre-clinical disease development and treatment of IBD. You will join an active group of dedicated biostatisticians and data scientists ensuring knowledge sharing and continuous professional development.

You will contribute to study planning, take responsibility for data management and statistical analyses of nationwide register data and large datasets collected in PREDICT, and contribute to the interpretation and reporting of the results, including co-authoring of scientific papers.

In addition to the biostatistical task, the position also includes the role of the primary technical contact person on our data infrastructure hosted on the National Genom Center’s HPC system. You will coordinate technical support, manage user access and onboarding, and assist researchers with data management, troubleshooting, and computational workflows. The role also involves ensuring secure handling of research data and contributing to the development and optimization of technical workflows.

Your competencies

Ideally, you have the following qualifications:

•    A master’s degree in statistics or equivalent

•    Experience conducting statistical analyses in epidemiological research

•    Knowledge about time-to-event analysis and related statistical methods.

•    Strong programming skills in R and/or Python

•    Experience in working with Linux-based computing environments

•    Experience working on High Performance Computing (HPC) systems

•    Experience with shell scripting for workflow automation and troubleshooting

•    Strong problem-solving skills and ability to support colleagues with technical challenges

Note that you must be qualified for both parts of the position to be taken into consideration.

Who we are

PREDICT was founded in 2021 and is at the forefront of international research to unravel the cause and prognosis of inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), which are chronic and disabling conditions affecting millions of people worldwide. The Center is composed of biologists, clinicians, epidemiologists, and data scientists working with collaborators nationally and internationally to push the boundaries of precision medicine research and create real-world impact in IBD. We have state-of-the-art facilities within the center and this means through PREDICT you will be part of a well-funded research environment equipped with the latest technologies, unique data, and a world-leading network of collaborators.

PREDICT has grown to become a world-renowned center, organized as a broad, national and interdisciplinary collaboration between Aalborg University and Aalborg University Hospital, with a multidisciplinary team of immunologists, geneticists, data scientists, clinicians and many more disciplines. Do you enjoy bringing people together, creating structure and making things happen? Are you motivated by developing others while ensuring that daily operations run smoothly – even when things get busy? Then you might be our new Team Leader for the evening shift in Fruit & Vegetables at Terminal Holme.

At Salling Group, we believe that good leadership is not just about having a title. It is about taking responsibility, setting clear expectations and helping others succeed.

We are looking for a leader who understands that strong performance and employee well-being go hand in hand.

**Your role – leading people and delivering results

**As Team Leader, you will be responsible for the daily operations of our evening shift, working closely with the Department Manager and your fellow leaders.Our evening shift operates from 12:00 to 20:00, and you will play a key role in ensuring that our colleagues have the right conditions to succeed and that our stores receive their deliveries on time.Your main responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop your team: Create direction, communicate expectations, provide feedback and support the development of colleagues and future leaders.

• Ensure strong daily operations: Plan staffing and resources, coordinate priorities and maintain an efficient operation with a high level of delivery accuracy.

• Drive continuous improvement: Challenge existing routines, involve colleagues in finding better solutions and use KPIs and LEAN principles to improve performance.

• Take ownership of safety and well-being: Create a working environment where everyone is treated with respect, safety comes first and challenges are addressed rather than ignored.

• Follow up and take action: Conduct daily team meetings, follow up on productivity, absence and performance, and ensure that decisions turn into action.

You will report to the Department Manager and become part of the Team Leader group at Terminal Holme.

Who are you?

We are looking for someone who wants to make a difference – both for the business and for the people they lead.

You are comfortable making decisions, including the difficult ones, and you understand that being a good leader sometimes means having honest conversations.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from warehouse operations, logistics or a similar operational environment.

• Have leadership experience or have demonstrated a strong ability to lead and develop others.

• Communicate clearly and confidently in both English and Danish.

• Are structured, solution-oriented and able to maintain an overview when priorities change.

• Take responsibility, follow through on commitments and lead by example.

Most importantly, you are genuinely interested in people. You listen, involve your colleagues and are willing to challenge them when needed.

We do not expect you to have all the answers. We do expect you to take ownership, be curious and have the courage to act.

What can you expect from us?

At Terminal Holme, we supply fresh fruit and vegetables to Bilka and føtex stores across Jutland and Funen.

You will join an international working environment with colleagues from many different backgrounds, where English is a natural part of everyday communication. Our operations run around the clock, and strong collaboration across shifts is essential.

You will become part of a leadership team that values open dialogue, accountability and continuous development.

Our leadership culture is built around a Culture of Care – where we care about our colleagues, challenge each other constructively and never compromise on safety or respect.

You will have the opportunity to influence how we work, develop your own leadership skills and contribute to building an even stronger team.

As part of Salling Group, you will also have access to our employee benefits programme, offering a range of attractive discounts and benefits across Salling Group's stores and businesses.

**Ready to take responsibility?

**If you recognise yourself in this description, we would like to hear from you.Apply here. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact:Kasper Dyndegaard MunkDepartment Manager – Fruit & VegetablesPhone: +45 61 77 33 75We look forward to hearing from you.

Agile Delivery Manager – Turn Priorities Into Progress at RiskPoint

On behalf of RiskPoint, we are looking for a structured and hands-on Agile Delivery Manager to join their growing IT-team. If you thrive on bringing people together, creating clarity across complex deliveries, and helping teams turn priorities into reliable outcomes, this could be your next career opportunity.

About RiskPoint:

RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing best-in-class insurance solutions backed by the insurance companies they represent.

As an Agile Delivery Manager at RiskPoint, you will become part of a growing IT-organisation, working closely with colleagues across technology and the business. You will play a key role in driving delivery across teams, functions, and external partners, both in Denmark and the rest of the world.

RiskPoint operates in an agile and collaborative environment, with strong cross-border cooperation across all business lines. With a flat organisational structure and a culture built on trust and responsibility, RiskPoint offers employees the opportunity to make a real impact, take ownership, and grow both personally and professionally.

About the Position:

As an Agile Delivery Manager at RiskPoint, you will play a central role in turning priorities into structured and predictable delivery. You will be responsible for coordinating work across teams and stakeholders, establishing a clear delivery rhythm, and ensuring that dependencies, risks, and decisions are identified and addressed at the right time.

This position goes beyond traditional project management. You will support agile ways of working, helping teams plan, prioritise, and deliver effectively, while respecting the responsibilities of Product Owners and the teams' ownership of their day-to-day activities.

The position is based onsite at RiskPoint's Copenhagen office, with occasional domestic and international travel.

You will report to Programme Manager, Christoffer Marcus Tøttrup, who is based in Copenhagen.

Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

• 
Drive day-to-day delivery coordination across multiple teams, stakeholders, and external partners

• 
Turn agreed priorities and outcomes into clear, realistic, and well-sequenced delivery plans

• 
Facilitate planning sessions, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant delivery meetings

• 
Create and maintain a transparent delivery rhythm with clear milestones, commitments, and follow-up

• 
Identify and coordinate cross-team dependencies and help resolve blockers before they affect delivery

• 
Maintain clear visibility of progress, risks, issues, decisions, and required escalations

• 
Coordinate release and implementation activities, including readiness, testing, approvals, communication, and handover

• 
Help teams apply practical agile methods suited to the work, rather than following a fixed framework for its own sake

• 
Support continuous improvement of delivery practices, governance, collaboration, and ways of working

• 
Provide clear and concise status updates to stakeholders and management

• 
Help build a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, cooperation, and reliable follow-through

Please note that applicants must currently reside in Denmark and hold a valid work and residence permit. Fluency in both written and spoken Danish and English is required.

Your Profile – A great Match for RiskPoint:

For this position, we are looking for a structured, proactive, and collaborative Agile Delivery Manager who thrives on creating clarity, driving progress, and bringing people together across teams and functions.

You have a relevant educational background in business, technology, project management, or a related field. However, your practical experience and ability to turn priorities into tangible results are more important than your formal qualifications.

We expect you to have a minimum of 4–5 years of professional experience in agile delivery, project delivery, Scrum Master roles, delivery coordination, or a similar position. You have a proven track record of supporting teams and stakeholders in translating priorities into structured execution and measurable outcomes.

To succeed in this role, you should bring:

• 
Hands-on experience with agile ways of working and the ability to adapt them to different teams and types of work

• 
Experience planning and coordinating delivery across several stakeholders, teams, or external partners

• 
The ability to identify dependencies, risks, blockers, and decisions and ensure they are followed through

• 
Experience facilitating meetings and creating clear actions, ownership, and next steps

• 
Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to make complex delivery topics easy to understand

• 
A structured approach to planning, documentation, status reporting, and follow-up

• 
The confidence to challenge unclear priorities, unrealistic commitments, and missing ownership in a constructive way

• 
Experience using common planning and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms

It-is furthermore a requirement that you have a proven track record of working effectively in team settings, communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and building trusted relationships across organisational boundaries.

To be successful in this role, they expect you to take ownership, create structure without unnecessary process, communicate clearly, and stay focused on progress and outcomes. You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change and where good delivery depends on close collaboration.

Although not required, RiskPoint would prefer candidates who have:

• 
Experience with software delivery, testing, release, and implementation processes

• 
Experience working with distributed or cross-border teams

• 
Certified in Scrum, agile delivery, or project management

Ready for the next step?

If you see yourself in this role, feel free to reach out to us for a confidential conversation. We look forward to hearing from you!

Experienced Backend Developer for UBsend A/S

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Travel: Approximately 10-30 days per year

Looking for the next step in your career?

Do you have 4-5 years+ of experience as a software developer? Are you eager to play a central role in a highly skilled team? Do you want to work with the latest technologies on a cloud-native platform and be part of an exciting scale-up company with the potential to disrupt the transportation and logistics industry?

If so, our IT department in Copenhagen is looking for an ambitious, dedicated and skilled backend developer to build and maintain a best-in-class IT solution.

Who is UBsend?

UBsend is a scale-up company aiming for developing and implementing state-of-the-art logistic solutions within the parcel industry. We ensure that companies of all sizes receive optimal solutions for their parcels in terms of carrier selection, lead time, prices, track and trace and customer experience. We strive to be the leading integration platform, growing rapidly and working with many well-known B2B and B2C clients. We are a company with a multinational culture, counting roughly 80 employees between our offices in Aarhus and Copenhagen. We keep the daily motivation high through social events and a down-to-earth tone with lots of humor and an inclusive atmosphere.

The IT Department

You will join our IT department of 22 colleagues. The department is responsible for developing new products and components and maintaining existing integrations between carriers and customers. Projects and solutions you will work on include:

• Development and implementation of a new enterprise platform in microservice architecture

• Development of carrier and transportation integrations

• Track and trace and event management

Our solutions are developed with an object-oriented approach, utilizing software design patterns when relevant. We aim to deliver the best solutions for our customers while enjoying an informal culture. We use Scrum methodologies and apply test-driven and domain-driven development with API-first approaches.

Key Technologies

Our technology stack includes:

• Languages & Frameworks: Java 17+21, Spring Boot, NodeJS, TypeScript, Angular CLI

• Data & Messaging: Confluent Kafka, Spring Data, MongoDB, Elasticsearch

• Infrastructure: Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, Terraform, Helm, Azure, Maven, BitBucket + Pipelines, Grafana

The position

Your main task will be to develop and maintain state-of-the-art applications, creating a solid and smooth foundation for operations. You will work with Microsoft Azure as our infrastructure platform. You will be given significant responsibility and the opportunity to implement your ideas in a team-oriented environment.

Daily Tasks

• Building new features into our native cloud microservices Java platform

• Conducting thorough code reviews (e.g., pull-requests) and working closely with QA

• Integrating with partners to produce the best possible integrations

• Defining and implementing automated testing to support our CI & CD

• Defining architectural solutions and improvements for the services you work on

• Identifying and defining viable improvements to our way of working

• Designing solutions with IT colleagues and business counterparts

• Sharing knowledge and experiences with your team members and colleagues

Qualifications

• More than 4 years of experience in Java (primary programming language)

• Writing maintainable (clean, readable, reusable and well documented) code

• Extensive knowledge of software design patterns and principles

• Familiarity with relational and document databases. We use MongoDB

• Experience with microservices architecture and design-first principles of APIs

• Familiarity with Microsoft Azure as a platform

• Excellent English communication skills (company language)

• Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in CS / Software Engineering (or related fields)

Your profile

We tackle a wide range of projects, so if you love staying busy and enjoy variety in your workday, you'll fit right in with us. You have an entrepreneurial spirit and always go the extra mile to achieve your goals and meet deadlines.

Since we're not a large corporate IT department, you'll be given significant responsibility, making it crucial that you're comfortable making independent decisions when needed. You bring a positive and innovative mindset and aren't afraid to pitch and implement your ideas. You thrive in an informal environment and are eager to both learn more and share your knowledge. In short – you're a proactive “go-getter” who loves a challenge!

We look forward to hearing from you

If you have any questions, please contact IT manager Jesper Elgaard at jesper.elgaard@ubsend.com.

Please note that we are already covered by agencies in this area, and we are not interested in being contacted by external agencies regarding this vacancy.

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible. We’re doing ongoing interviews and will remove this listing once we’ve found the right new colleague.

What we offer you:

• Open workplace culture focused on ownership, initiative, and team execution based in Aarhus with colleagues in Warsaw.

jobs.occupation: Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics
jobs.description:
Aalborg University is seeking an outstanding Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics to lead the newly established Research Center for Energy Mathematics, a strategic collaboration with Centrica Energy.

As the Centrica Energy Chair, you will work at the interface of academic research and challenges in energy markets, quantitative analytics, data science, and algorithmic decision-making.

Your work tasks

This is primarily a research and research-leadership position. You will conduct international leading research in energy mathematics, develop a long-term research agenda, publish in top-journals, attract external funding, and strengthen Aalborg University's position in the field.

As Director of the Research Center for Energy Mathematics, you will build and lead a research community of PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, visiting scholars and international collaborators. Collaboration with Centrica Energy will provide opportunities to engage in real-world challenges while preserving academic freedom and the highest scientific standards. You will supervise PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and master’s students. Teaching and administrative responsibilities are expected to be limited and organized to support the position’s focus on research and research leadership.

The aim is to establish a globally recognized center that advances fundamental and applied research in energy mathematics and contributes to academia, society, and the green energy transition

**Who we are looking for

**

We seek a researcher with a strong academic track record and the ambition to shape the emerging field of energy mathematics. Relevant expertise may include stochastic optimization, stochastic analysis, uncertainty quantification, mathematical modelling, machine learning, causal inference, computational mathematics, or related disciplines.

We welcome candidates with mathematical depth and broad intellectual curiosity, especially researchers who address fundamental questions about complex and uncertain energy systems and markets across traditional disciplinary boundaries. Applicants must demonstrate research experience at the highest international level through an outstanding publication record, doctoral supervision, competitive research funding and international collaboration.

In addition to scientific excellence, we are looking for a colleague who is enthusiastic about building and leading a collaborative research environment and with an openness to dialogue with industry.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must be able to document a high degree of original academic production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels. Including tests/exams, course/study programme management as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material.

Emphasis is placed on the extent, to which the applicant, has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

Emphasis may moreover be placed on the applicant’s ability to carry out and develop research-based public-sector consultancy. Also, emphasis will be placed on an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks and possibly fulfil other functions, for example in relation to the university’s external cooperation.

Emphasis will also be placed on the applicant's ability to undertake pedagogical supervision, supervision and academic assessment work.

Additional q ualification requirements

Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in mathematics or in a closely related discipline and have a sustained record of original and influential research.

Emphasis will be placed on the ability to formulate and pursue ambitious research agendas and to establish and lead an internationally recognized research environment. Experience with competitive research funding, international collaboration, and mentoring doctoral and postdoctoral researchers is important.

Applicants must preferably document university teaching and supervision experience at the undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral level.

Leadership experience with research teams, centers, or large collaborative projects is a strong plus. The ability to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and engage with partners in academia, industry, and the public sector is also valued.

The assessment will consider scientific achievements, academic leadership, educational contributions, supervision experience, international standing, and the potential to strengthen Aalborg University's research and education in energy mathematics.

Who we are

The position is anchored at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at Aalborg University, one of Scandinavia's leading environments for applied mathematics, stochastic modelling, and data-driven research. The department offers an international and collaborative research environment with strong links to academia, industry, and society.

The Research Center for Energy Mathematics is established through a strategic collaboration between Aalborg University and Centrica Energy, a leading European energy trading and energy management company active in power, gas, renewable energy, algorithmic trading, analytics, and quantitative research. While the professorship is an independent academic position at Aalborg University, the collaboration with Centrica Energy provides exceptional opportunities for research inspiration, access to relevant data and problems, and interaction with leading practitioners in quantitative energy trading and analytics.

Together, Aalborg University and Centrica Energy aim to create a globally recognized center in energy mathematics that attracts outstanding researchers and students from around the world.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of ten publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, The Faculty of Engineering and Science and The Faculty of Medicine. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Professor”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
